name: University of the Arts London
summary: Art, design, fashion and media across London colleges such as Central Saint Martins; most BAs ask modest IB points, then judge your portfolio.

ib.text: On 2026-entry pages most BAs asked 24–25 points; applicants who meet that send a digital portfolio. IB English A at HL 5 or SL 6 proves your English.

dates.label: UCAS equal consideration deadline, 18:00 UK time

programmes.name: Fine Art
programmes.about: At Chelsea College of Arts: an experimental course built around exhibitions, projects, publications and performances, where you develop your own independent art practice and set it in a wider social context.
programmes.ib: 25 points minimum, plus three GCSE passes at grade 4 or above. Entry also depends on your portfolio and an interview.
programmes.selectionNote: After your UCAS application you send a digital portfolio, then are interviewed. Places stay open after the January date until filled.

flagshipSource.title: Fine Art at Chelsea: alumni include many Turner Prize winners and nominees (course page)

programmes.name: Graphic Communication Design
programmes.about: At Central Saint Martins: creative, conceptual, technical and critical skills for 21st-century designers, across a range of graphic communication practices that cross traditional boundaries, used to tackle environmental and social questions.
programmes.ib: 24 points, plus three GCSE passes at grade 4 or above. Entry is also decided by your portfolio.
programmes.selectionNote: After your UCAS application you send a digital portfolio, then are interviewed. A very high share of successful applicants have an art foundation diploma.

flagshipSource.title: Graphic Communication Design at Central Saint Martins: a breadth of graphic practices and platforms (course page)

programmes.name: Fashion Design Technology: Womenswear
programmes.about: At London College of Fashion: an in-depth study of womenswear design, technology and production, with brand links and a short industry placement, plus sustainable production and inclusive design.
programmes.ib: 25 points minimum, plus three GCSE passes at grade 4 or above. Entry is also decided by your portfolio.
programmes.selectionNote: After your UCAS application you send a digital portfolio, then are interviewed.

flagshipSource.title: Fashion Design Technology: Womenswear: links with brands such as Marc Jacobs and Simone Rocha (course page)

notes: After UAL checks your UCAS application it asks for a digital portfolio through PebblePad; Fine Art, for example, allows at most 30 pages.
International fees for 2027 entry were not yet published; for 2026 entry a BA cost £30,890 a year, and fees can rise up to 5% a year during the course.
Central Saint Martins no longer runs a standalone architecture BA; for 2027 entry, UAL points you to its Integrated MArch, which combines BA and MA study.

faculties.name: Camberwell College of Arts
faculties.line: Nine BAs: fine art in four media, graphic design, illustration, interior architecture, landscape design.

faculties.name: Central Saint Martins
faculties.line: Sixteen BAs, fashion to fine art to product design; most applicants have an art foundation diploma; portfolio decides.

faculties.name: Chelsea College of Arts
faculties.line: Fine Art, graphic design, interior, product and furniture design, textiles; Fine Art asks 25 points and a portfolio.

faculties.name: London College of Communication
faculties.line: Media, film, animation, games, photography, journalism and sound; each course sets its own IB points.

faculties.name: London College of Fashion
faculties.line: Fashion design, business, communication, styling and costume; Womenswear asks 25 points and a portfolio.

faculties.name: Wimbledon College of Arts
